title: Update package list
desc: Refresh the list of available packages. Do this first before installing anything.

title: Update system (Linux)
desc: Update all installed packages on Debian/Ubuntu based Linux.
cmd: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y

title: Install a package
desc: Install any app or tool. Replace 'package-name' with the real name.

title: Install a package (Linux)
desc: Install a package on Debian/Ubuntu systems.

title: See files in current folder
desc: Lists all files and folders in the folder you're currently inside.

title: Go into a folder
desc: Change directory into another folder. Replace 'folder-name'.

title: Go back one folder
desc: Move up one level in the folder tree.

title: Where am I?
desc: Shows the full path of the folder you're currently in.

title: Create an empty file
desc: Makes a new empty text file with the name you give.

title: Create a folder
desc: Makes a new folder (directory).

title: Delete a file
desc: Permanently removes a file. ⚠️ Cannot be undone!

title: Delete a folder
desc: Removes a folder and everything inside it. ⚠️ Dangerous!

title: Copy a file
desc: Copies a file from one place to another.

title: Move / Rename a file
desc: Moves a file or renames it.

title: Read a text file
desc: Shows the contents of a text file in the terminal.

title: Edit a file
desc: Open a file in the nano text editor. Ctrl+O to save, Ctrl+X to exit.

title: Search inside files
desc: Find a word inside files in the current folder.

title: Check disk space
desc: Shows how much storage is used and free.

title: Check running processes
desc: Shows all currently running processes and their CPU/memory usage.

title: Kill a process
desc: Stops a running process. Get the PID from 'top' first.

title: Check internet connection
desc: Pings Google to test if you're online.

title: Download a file
desc: Downloads a file from a URL to your current folder.

title: Install Git
desc: Installs Git so you can clone GitHub repos.

title: Clone a GitHub repo
desc: Downloads a GitHub repository to your device.

title: Clear the terminal
desc: Clears all the text on your terminal screen.

title: Show command history
desc: Shows all commands you've typed before.

title: Get help for any command
desc: Shows the manual/help page for any command.

title: Change file permissions
desc: Makes a file executable (e.g. a script).

title: Run a script
desc: Executes a shell script file.

title: Show current date and time
desc: Displays the system date and time.

title: Show system info
desc: Shows OS, kernel, and hardware information.

title: Exit Termux
desc: Closes the current Termux session.
